name: measure_model
description: Return the model's measurable proportions: total bounding box (width/height/depth in units), each top-level bone's size, and key ratios (width:height, depth:height, head_height_fraction). Use it to match a reference NUMERICALLY (e.g. 'head should be ~1/4 of total height') — complements compare_reference's silhouette score. Bounds are axis-aligned (rotation ignored), which is fine for proportion checks.
